crossRefs.note: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.
He said, “You cannot see my face, for man may not see me and live.”
No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of…
Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and…

translations.web: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
translations.bsb: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading over it His cloud.
translations.kjv: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud
translations.asv: He incloseth the face of his throne, And spreadeth his cloud upon it.
